exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix mem-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: mem-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card apply graph.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/apply.txt
exec card state set mem-3 'Primary recovery state.'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/state-set.txt
exec card state append mem-3 'Secondary detail.'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/state-append.txt
exec card state show mem-3
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/state.txt

exec card --actor 'Jean-Luc Picard' log add mem-3 'Workstream log entry.'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/log-add.txt
exec card log list mem-3
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/log.txt

exec card show --context --context-depth 1 mem-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/show-context.txt
exec card --actor riker log add mem-2 'Second task historical detail.'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/second-log-add.txt
exec card --actor riker claim --context mem-2
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/claim-context.txt
exec card log list mem-2
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/second-log.txt

exec card close mem-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/close-first.txt
exec card list --under mem-3 --status closed
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/closed-descendants.txt

exec card state discard mem-3
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/state-discard.txt
